answer:
Subject: Request for Adjusted Schedule – Medical Accommodation

Dear Tom Reyes,

I am writing to inform you that I have recently been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes at Hanbit Clinic. As I begin treatment and establish a management routine, I will need a more flexible work schedule over the next two months to attend medical appointments, monitor blood‑glucose levels, and adjust to new medication timing.

I would like to propose the following temporary adjustments, effective immediately and lasting through the next eight weeks:

* Core hours: 10:00 am – 3:00 pm (available for meetings and collaboration)
* Flexible start/end times outside core hours to accommodate appointments
* Option to work remotely on days when clinic visits run longer than expected

I will keep you updated on any changes and ensure that all deliverables remain on track. Please let me know a convenient time to discuss this further.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

Best regards,  
Jane Park  
jane.park@example.com | 010-5555-0142
